audit.question: Does VulcanForgeUI replace an accessibility audit?
audit.answer: No. It helps detect common issues and document manual checks, but it does not replace a complete accessibility audit.

exports.question: Can I use the exports in real projects?
exports.answer: Yes. The MVP focuses on practical outputs such as CSS variables, Tailwind v4 snippets, TypeScript themes and React Native theme objects.

billing.question: Is billing available in the MVP?
billing.answer: No. The first version is designed as a free beta so the core product value can be validated before adding paid plans.

finalCta.title: Build your next design system with a stronger foundation.

betaNotice.title: No fake billing in the MVP.
betaNotice.description: The MVP does not include Stripe or paid subscriptions. This page presents the intended pricing direction while keeping the beta experience honest and free.

whyFree.question: Why is the beta free?
whyFree.answer: Because the first goal is to validate the workflow: create, structure, validate, preview and export a design system.

billing.question: Will billing be added later?
billing.answer: Yes, but only after the product proves enough value to justify paid plans.

limits.question: Will the beta have limits?
limits.answer: The first beta can stay intentionally limited to keep the product focused and stable.
